annotations.title: ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 SEPA & SPS Payment Generator

description: [$0.04 USDC via x402] Stateless JSON-to-ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 credit transfer XML generator with exact Decimal CtrlSum, SPS 2026 & EPC SEPA structured postal addresses, IBAN Mod-97, and BIC checks.

compliance_profile.description: Address rule profile: SPS_2026_AND_SEPA or EPC_SEPA_TRANSITION

debtor.description: Ordering debtor account holder details and structured postal address

address.description: Structured or hybrid postal address with town_name and country

bic.description: Optional Debtor agent BICFI (8 or 11 chars)

execution_date.description: Requested execution date in YYYY-MM-DD format

message_id.description: Optional Group Header MsgId (max 35 SWIFT FIN-X chars)

transactions.description: Non-empty list of credit transfer instructions with amount, currency, creditor_name, creditor_iban, and creditor_address

items.description: Single SEPA or ISO 20022 credit transfer instruction

amount.description: Positive decimal transfer amount such as 1250.50

creditor_address.description: Beneficiary structured or hybrid postal address

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code such as EUR or CHF

scor_reference.description: Optional ISO 11649 RF structured creditor reference

name: iso20022_generate_pain001
title: ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 SEPA & SPS Payment Generator
